role: Independent Yggdrasil research contributor. Amalgam PR #1278 alone coordinates canonical model and checkpoint integration.
scope: fresh source-free synthetic development only, candidate isolated native context basis and NKR08 factual overlay, no accepted model, no protected original first-use
knowledge_source: NKR08 engineering-only synthetic direct Q/P/Q observations; predicates 930 to 933 as interchangeable candidate binary features; do not encode causal role in any candidate API
causal_source: Separately disclosed deterministic synthetic action->reward witnesses; unknown true predicate role is simulator-private and not passed to selector
mode_balance: 16 of each mode separately in FIT and HELD, independently seeded; distractors are 8/8 within each FIT true-mode group so non-causal predicates cannot perfectly fit
training_actions: both binary actions per 32 FIT entity per phase. Total exactly 384 development witness action outcomes; no held outcome enters training or feature selection
held_metric: 384 disjoint entity-action predictions over 3 seeds x 2 phases x 32 held entities x 2 actions, exact mean Brier, action preference, and action-supported classification
hypothesis: NativeContextBasis can learn the uniquely causal candidate predicate from witnessed action-consequence contrasts WITHOUT a supplied role index, and generalize to held source entity IDs. This must tie a fully-fitted feature-tournament symbolic/tree control and must not be claimed science.
candidate: Original yggdrasil.native_context_basis.NativeContextBasis(context_bits=1,max_degree=1); fit candidate bit/action/outcome for each one of four predicates, reject any inconsistent conditional model, select only exactly one model that fits all witnessed training actions; use independent slot addresses by phase and report that retention is structural isolation.
matched_controls: Exhaustive symbolic candidate-property conditional counts and same candidate selection, using identical factual attributes and witnessed rows
Fully fitted exhaustive one-predicate depth-two tree trained over each candidate property and action, with same role-selection information
Action-only phase-aware baseline with no property bit

gates.engineering: all 6 seed-phase source selections unique; all native supported held predictions correct; exact symbolic/tree parity; all 384 held pairs scored; cold restoration; source facts, historical first/last and archived parent unchanged; negative controls for ties, missing or conflicting source feature, no policy activation
gates.scientific: Requires >=0.01 lower held Brier than *each* strongest fully fitted equal-info control, old retained ability, independent original-world lease/held cohort and cost; equal zero Brier tie is DEV_NO_GO not success
gates.failure: Preserve failures; no rerun of same held synthetic draws with changed roles/thresholds

stop: Single frozen experiment after exact-source dual-OS engineering qualification. No new original-world first-use, official model owner executor, merge, deployment, controller, schedule, paid API or additional seed draws.
decision: ENGINEERING_PASS only if test and source CI; scientific_pass false if exact control ties; all results source-free development and not independent science
